::: {.task-list .drill}

::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> A trading game: I flip a coin twenty times and you may buy or sell a contract that pays the number of heads. I quote you 9 at 11. What do you do, and how does your answer change if I quote 9 at 11 after seeing the first five flips and you have not?

<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The million dollar question, first attempt: what would you do with a million dollars? Answer out loud in ninety seconds. :::
